text:
frank: small heads-up: a new user reported onboarding friction with the Ruby sample-app. their `bundle install` fails because the gemfile pins `ffi` to a version that conflicts with linux-musl docker images.

mei: ugh we've seen that. which sample-app? the quickstart or examples/no-auth?

frank: quickstart. they pasted logs: `Gem::Ext::BuildError: ERROR: Failed to build gem native extension.` they were on alpine-based Docker.

tomo: quick fix is to avoid building native extensions in the container by using the `ruby:alpine` with `build-base` or use `ruby:slim` for CI. but better long-term: relax the `ffi` pin in the sample-app gemfile and add platform instructions.

mei: agree. proposed changes: 1) loosen `ffi` constraint from `~> 1.15` to `>= 1.15`, 2) add Docker Compose dev file using `ruby:slim`, and 3) add a short note in README about Alpine caveats.

frank: also a minimal workaround we can document: set `bundle config set force_ruby_platform true` before `bundle install` to skip native compile and use the ruby platform gem when available. worth adding as a troubleshooting tip.

qa-bot: :white_check_mark: QA note: add test case in CI to run `sample-apps/quickstart` container build on ubuntu and alpine images to catch regressions. file: .github/workflows/sample-apps.yml suggestion.

mei: minor UX question for the sample apps: should we keep a single Gemfile for all examples or split per-example so dependencies don't collide? splitting reduces friction but increases duplication. thoughts?

tomo: split per-example. keeps each example minimal and easier to copy-paste for users. we can extract common gems into a `Gemfile.common` and optionally `bundle install --gemfile` in CI.

frank: ok let's split. i'll open PR with: gemfile relax, alpine note, docker-compose, and CI matrix test (ubuntu/slim/alpine). link when ready.

ci-bot: :robot_face: FYI tests in previous PR flaked on mac runner due to system openssl mismatch when building `openssl` ext. see issue https://ci.example.com/999/logs. consider pinning ruby versions in the matrix.

mei: thanks. small follow-up: add a tiny CONTRIBUTING.md section for maintainers on how to run sample-apps locally (commands and expected output) and mention `bundle config set force_ruby_platform true` as a troubleshooting item.

frank: sounds good. also add a one-line note in the SDK README about platform constraints for CI on Hosted vs Dedicated customers. we had a support ticket where a Dedicated customer used an internal musl-based builder and hit the same issue.

tomo: when you open the PR, add `cc @devex` and include the CI job logs inline so reviewers can reproduce quickly.

frank: will do. aiming to ship PR in the morning. thanks all :rocket:
